facts.fact: The article says President Boakai signed the Cybercrime Act into law on 19 August 2026 and that the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications has published the approved Act.

Police arrested Jerry Nyantee Wrotto over the weekend before 21 September 2026 over AI-generated images of Vice President Koung, and the Inspector General confirmed the arrest was made under the Cybercrime Law; no court had yet ruled on the conduct.

systems.owner: Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications (published); Liberia National Police (enforcement)

note: Arrest date given only as the weekend before publication; published date used.
